eps.o: Sticky Joe loses his shoe, and his search takes him on another wild adventure.
The Titans must clean the Tower for a surprise inspection.
When the Titans' real ages are revealed, they must think and act like teenagers to remain Teen Titans.
Inspired by a commercial, the Titans visit Dr. Light and Dr. Moon to learn how to make extra money.
Control Freak tries once more to convince the Titans that the original show is the superior series.
Cyborg and Beast Boy realize that what they order to eat at a diner might have much bigger consequences.
While shopping at the mall, the Titans enter a contest to win a hot tub.

eps.t: Teen Titans and the Easter Factory
eps.o: Will a trip to the Eastory Factory be a magical time for the Titans or is it another one of the Easter Bunny's tricks?
Lex Luthor buys the Titans' island and shows them how to make passive income through real estate.
After they receive a distress call, Robin, Raven, and Birdarang rush off to help the Winged Warriors, a society dedicated to birds.
Robin installs two security cameras to catch the thief who keeps stealing his overnight oats.
It's Mother's Day, and the Titans compete to determine which of them is the best mom and deserves all the gifts.
Robin hosts a DC Comics book club, but the other Titans may not have done the assigned reading.
Robin finds it suspicious that the Titans are always nominated for an award but never win and is determined to find out why.
The Titans' day at the beach is interrupted by something vicious in the ocean.
The Titans encourage King Shark to start playing pool again, but he must first learn how to trust his gut.
King Shark wears a tank top and teaches the Titans all about the "tank life."
While at the lake, Robin falls in love with a female fish and must choose between her and the Titans.
The Titans face-off against a giant shark but soon discover that things are not what they seem.
Robin becomes the leader of the Joker team in a DC superhero exchange show, and vice versa.
The Titans attempt to transport the sleeping gray gorilla that destroyed the Titans Tower back to the zoo without waking it.
Robin is ready to answer a crime alert, but the other Titans are in no rush.
After defeating Brother Blood, the Titans reward themselves with a trip to the salon.
The Titans decide to not produce a Halloween special this year, but soon discover that they may not have a choice.
While on a trip to Boston, the Titans enlist the help of Deadman in order to search for a legendary bowl of clam chowder.
The Wonder Twins teach the Titans about water conservation.
Beast Boy and Cyborg disguise themselves as ice villains at the Cold Academy in order to help Captain Cold.
Cyborg's birthday wish goes wrong and everything becomes cake.
A look behind the scenes of the story of Teen Titans Go!.
The Titans get stuck in the swamp and learn the truth about the Hall of Doom.
After an eventful night, Birdarang and Batarang must retrace their steps to find the Batmobile.
In order to get their Christmas presents back, the Titans are forced to play a game of White Elephant.
Robin teaches the other Titans how to properly use a ruler.
Out of boredom, Starfire and Cyborg repeatedly call the Hero Hotline for housework help, but soon there is a real crime alert.
When the Teen Titans are banished to the Elseworlds, they try to find a way back to the main DC universe timeline.
The Monitor tries to make the Titans use their powers properly instead of the silly ways they've been used in the past.
Tired of fighting low tier villains, the Titans seek out Amanda Waller so they can join Task Force X.
While visiting Philadelphia, the Titans join forces with the Bacon Brothers to stop William Penn's rampage on the city.
The League of Legs returns to help stop crime and learn about the importance of leg washing.
Robin, Cyborg and Raven are zapped into a book, and must rely on Beast Boy and Starfire to make the right selections of their choice in order to escape.
Except for Raven, all of our friends cannot wait to go to the Renaissance Festival in their costume.
In an attempt to escape from the Joker, the Titans try to make him laugh with various comedy acts.
Batman and Commissioner Gordon install a satellite dish so they can watch a wide variety of shows.
After the Thread of Time is corrupted, the Titans travel through time to correct historical events.

eps.t: Teen Titans Go to the Repair Shop (1)
eps.o: While in London to stop Mad Mod, the Titans' crime-fighting weapons are damaged.

eps.t: Teen Titans Go to the Repair Shop (2)
eps.o: The Repair Shop crew are pushed to the limit while fixing the Titans' gear so they can stop Mad Mod.
Robin must learn the ways of sport anime in order to defeat a rival fisherman.
The Titans are surprised to find there's still something out there running amok.
It's the Titans vs. the Justice League in a DC edition of Hollywood Squares, with Weird Al in the center square.

eps.t: The Night Begins to Shine - Vinyl City (1)
eps.o: Cyborg gets a call from B.E.R. to help restore the Key to the City. Break Beat offers to help, but secretly steals the key instead, forcing Cyborg to reunite with the Titans and track her down to get it back.

eps.t: The Night Begins to Shine - Vinyl City (2)
eps.o: Cyborg finally finds the Titans, but before they can come up with a plan to get the Key to the City back, they're forced into an arena battle where they'll have to fight their way out.

eps.t: The Night Begins to Shine - Vinyl City (3)
eps.o: Break Beat corrupts the Key to the City, and before the Titans can stop her, she uses it to corrupt the entire city. When B.E.R. is hurt in the chaos, they snap and unleash a giant 3D robot to destroy the city. With everything falling apart, the Titans must find a way to stop the robot, save the city, and undo the corruption before it's too late.
